text:
Elena (Design): Quick design review request — iterating on the Credentials dashboard (create / rotate / revoke flows). pasted a mock in the doc: https://redwood/drive/credentials-redesign.jpg. can folks skim? :pray:
Jorge (PM): Nice. Main asks: make rotate flow less scary for new users, and surface RBAC scoping earlier. also we need copy that explains exposures for embeddings keys vs general API keys.
Sam (Engineering): skimmed — technical constraint: we can only show last 4 chars of a key after creation. so any 'show full key' must be one-time on create.
Elena (Design): yup — mock shows one-time full key reveal. question: should we block rotate unless user has active replacement key? or show a warning?
Dylan (Design Manager): prefer a permissive rotate but stronger inline warning and a checklist. if rotation will break running services, show a 'dependency scan' prompt. maybe a lightweight inline checklist: "Has this key been updated in X services?"
Priya (A11y): a11y nits: modal focus trap — when rotate modal opens, focus should go to heading and then the primary action. warn copy should be read by screen readers; include `role=alert` for the irreversible warning. contrast for the red warning pill is below AA currently.
Sam (Engineering): for dependency scan we can run a quick last-7-days logs lookup, but that's async. maybe show "Potential impacted services: N (estimate)" and link to run a deeper check.
Jorge (PM): on scoping — propose two affordances in create flow: (1) key purpose free-text (optional) and (2) scope toggles (embeddings-only / generation / admin). default to least privilege.
Elena (Design): made two variants: A) compact create inline switches, B) stepped modal with scope on step 2. Which feels less noisy?
Dylan (Design Manager): A is cleaner for power users; B is better for clarity and for copy guidance. I'd A/B test by region.
Priya (A11y): Whichever we pick, ensure keyboard-only users can toggle the scope switches and that screen reader announces the resulting permissions (e.g., "This key allows embeddings only").
Sam (Engineering): implementation detail: scope toggles map to token claims; we need to persist intent in audit logs. also add a `created_by` metadata.
Elena (Design): copy ideas for rotate modal (short): 1) heading: "Rotate key — will invalidate current key" 2) body: "Services using this key may fail until updated. We will only display the new key once." 3) primary: "Rotate and copy new key" 4) secondary: "Rotate and keep old key active" (this second option is only for enterprise dedicated customers). Thoughts?
Jorge (PM): prefer clearer verbs: primary: `Rotate and reveal` maybe too vague. "Rotate and copy new key" reads odd. How about primary: `Rotate and reveal new key` and a small subtext `New key shown only once — be sure to store it.`
Priya (A11y): avoid 'copy' as the primary action label — action verbs should describe the change, not the UI artifact. `Rotate and reveal` is ok, add tooltip on why we show once. Also ensure the modal has a confirmation checkbox for destructive actions: `I understand that rotating will invalidate the old key.`
Dylan (Design Manager): checkbox is good for critical keys. For low-privilege keys, maybe skip to avoid friction. We can gate checkbox by scope (admin-level keys require explicit confirmation).
Sam (Engineering): also add rate-limited revoke endpoint. we should expose a revoke "soft" which deactivates without deletion for 24h for quick rollbacks. UI needs to reflect that state: `Deactivated — can be reactivated within 24h` with clear affordance.
Elena (Design): empty state for credentials page — current mock has a big illustration + CTA "Create your first key". Copy alternatives: A) "Create a key to start calling Redwood" B) "No keys yet — generate one to get started." Prefer short.
Jorge (PM): include a small tip under CTA: `Tip: create embedding-only keys for vector workloads to reduce blast radius.`
Priya (A11y): empty state buttons need focus outlines and descriptive aria-labels. CTA should be `Create key` rather than `Create` for clarity.
Sam (Engineering): telemetry: add `created_from_console` attribute so we can see how many are console-generated vs API. useful for PLG funnels.
Elena (Design): about table layout — we currently show name, last used, scope, actions. can we add quick copy icon next to key for recently created rows only?
Sam (Engineering): copy icon only when full key is available (just after create). otherwise show masked with `••••1234` and an overflow menu for rotate/revoke.
Dylan (Design Manager): overflow menu ordering: primary action (Rotate) first, then Revoke, then Edit metadata. For keyboard users, menus should open on Enter/Space and focus the first menu item.
Priya (A11y): add aria-describedby to the rotate button linking to the modal's explanation. also ensure toast messages are announced. Example toast copy for success: `Key rotated. New key revealed — saved to clipboard.` For screen reader we should emit `role=status` message: `API key rotated successfully; new key shown once.`
Elena (Design): small copy question — badge when key hasn't been used in 90 days. label options: `Inactive`, `No recent usage`, `Not used recently`. Which is clearer?
Jorge (PM): `Inactive` might imply disabled. prefer `No recent usage` and tooltip `No requests in last 90 days.`
Sam (Engineering): backend can compute `last_used_at` and expose it. also add a `risk_score` attr for future filtering.
Elena (Design): final asks: I'll update mocks with (A) stepped create modal and (B) compact inline, add rotate modal with checkbox for admin scopes, and show soft-revoke banner. will post updated link in ~2 hours.
console-bot: Reminder — design review scheduled at 3pm today. Add updated mocks to the doc before the meeting. :calendar:
